name: Stevia

schedule.notes: Surface-sow; light required. Germination is low (30 to 50%) — overplant. Or skip seed and buy a plant.
Wait for warm soil and reliable nights.
Pick whole stems just before flowering — sweetness peaks. Cut back hard for a second flush.

harvest.cues: Plants 18 to 24 in tall, buds forming. Leaves are sweet at any stage but peak right before flowering.
harvest.storageNotes: Dry whole stems in shade; powder dried leaves in a coffee grinder. 1/4 tsp powder = 1 tbsp sugar.

varieties.name: Stevia
varieties.notes: Single cultivar in most garden seed. Vegetative propagation gives better-tasting plants than seed.

notes: Below zone 8 grow as an annual or overwinter indoors. Leaves are 30 to 40x sweeter than sugar by weight; small amount goes very far. Some people taste a licorice or bitter note — try a leaf before planting a big patch.
